title: Duplicate Badge
statement: A door scanner logs badge IDs as an array of integers. Return true if any badge ID appears more than once, otherwise false.

answerKey.pattern: Hash set to remember IDs already seen
keyPoints: For each ID: if it is already in the set return true, otherwise add it
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Nested loops comparing every pair: O(n^2) time, O(1) space
Sort then compare neighbours: O(n log n)

hints: Comparing every pair is O(n^2). What could you remember about the IDs you have already read?
A hash set answers "have I seen this before?" in O(1) on average.
Check the set before adding the current ID, and return as soon as you find a repeat.
